name: Adjournment of the Beautification and Maintenance Commission Meeting to October 19, 2023
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT
The July 20, 2023, regular meeting of the Beautification and Maintenance
Commission of the City of Artesia has been adjourned to 6:00 P.M. on
October 19, 2023, in the Council Chambers; 18747 Clarkdale Ave., Artesia,
California, 90701 due to a lack of quorum.

Dated: July 24, 2023

  Management Analyst
